title: Duality Between Injective Envelopes and Flat Covers over Noether Algebras
summary: It follows by Puuska that, over a commutative Noetherian ring $R$, a morphism $i : M \rightarrow I$ of $R$-modules is an injective envelope if and only if its Matlis dual $Hom_R(i, E)$ is a flat cover for some injective cogenerator $E$, and equivalently for every injective $R$-module $E$. In this paper, we will generalize this result to non-commutative Noetherian algebras.
